1793.dialogueHTML:
The Tome of Valor

Completion

It has been proven that the Light is with you, <name>, but as times grow more dangerous, it becomes important to know what strength lies beneath the flesh. When demons, dragons, or any other evil set foot in your lands, your mettle will be tested. Will you be strong enough?

Bravery, regardless of the situation, is as much a part of paladinhood as the Light, your armor, and your weapon. Protecting the weak, and not losing faith are two more lessons you must master while you study in the Cathedral of Light.

1649.dialogueHTML:
The Tome of Valor

Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

Description

Valor, and all the virtues that go along with it, are like rare minerals: you must cherish them when you find them because of their value, but you must also take time to harvest them... refine them. When mixed together properly, a strong alloy is formed, sometimes unbreakable by even the most powerful blows.

This strength, your faith, your bravery, must be tested. You must learn to never lose faith and realize that with the power of the Light, you can overcome things that most others cannot.

Completion

Ah, you wish to petition me for a test of valor. Splendid.

There are many tasks throughout the city and surrounding lands that hold much challenge, and they could use a man with your skills.

This test should not be taken lightly, <name>. This, like many things along our path, could take our lives. The Church always wishes to bolster its ranks, but it understands the sacrifices needed to ensure the paladins serving it are worthy.

Are you prepared?

1650.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 23[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=3][/li][li]Class: [class=2][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6171/duthorian-rall]Duthorian Rall[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6182/daphne-stilwell]Daphne Stilwell[/url][/icon][/li][li]Sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r1]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r2]21[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]26[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]31[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1650.dialogueHTML:
The Tome of Valor

Find Daphne Stilwell in Westfall.

Description

Good! Your lack of hesitation is a sure sign that you are prepared and eager to test yourself. So be it.

At the very ends of Westfall's Longshore, a small house overlooks the ocean. There, a couple lives, the Stilwells. Jordan is an incredible smith, and he's gone to Ironforge to meet with the dwarves for a while. But this has left Daphne, his wife, alone and unprotected.

Reports suggest that the Defias have all but taken over the area, Daphne may need some protection from the villains. Go there.

Completion

Hello, <name>. I'm assuming by all that armor and weapon of yours, you're either here to try and take my land, or the Church finally sent someone to help protect me while my Jordan's gone.

Well, let me introduce myself: I'm Daphne Stilwell. It's a pleasure.

Now, you're not too late... I've only killed a half dozen of the scum since last sun up. They've been a little slow getting 'round the bend up there, but they probably saw you coming, which means they'll probably be here any minute.
1650.sourceReview: Current own-ID script, infobox, original boundaries, five fields, linked identities, installed full record and all UA fields inspected. No primary unused/removed flag.

1651.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 25[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=3][/li][li]Class: [class=2][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6182/daphne-stilwell]Daphne Stilwell[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6182/daphne-stilwell]Daphne Stilwell[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=q10]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r1]21[/color][small]  [/small][color=r2]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]28[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]33[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1651.dialogueHTML:
The Tome of Valor

Defend Daphne Stilwell from the Defias attack.

Neither of your spirits must be released from their mortal coils if you wish to succeed.

After you are successful, speak to Daphne Stilwell again.

 

Protect Daphne Stilwell (1)

Description

Now, they'll be coming again soon, I'd wager, so get yourself ready.

I've got myself a gun in the house. I'll grab it and be ready to help you out, but for the most part, you're on your own.

I've no idea how many they'll send, but I'm sure it'll be more than the few they sent earlier.

Ask the Light for whatever blessings you can because... did you hear that? I think they're coming.

We make our stand near the house!

Progress

We'll make our stand at the house!

Completion

We've done it, <name>! Thank you for your help. You were truly amazing out there. I never thought a <class> could handle so many enemies at once.

You've truly shown bravery in the face of overwhelming odds.
1651.sourceReview: Current own-ID script, infobox, original boundaries, five fields, linked identities, installed full record and all UA fields inspected. No primary unused/removed flag.

1652.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 25[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=3][/li][li]Class: [class=2][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6182/daphne-stilwell]Daphne Stilwell[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6171/duthorian-rall]Duthorian Rall[/url][/icon][/li][li]Sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=q10]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r1]21[/color][small]  [/small][color=r2]23[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]28[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]33[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1652.dialogueHTML:
The Tome of Valor

Speak to Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

Description

Please, return to Duthorian and let him know that I'm safe for now. I have you and the Church to thank for that.

He'll send word to Ironforge to let my Jordan know that he has nothing to fear.

Oh, how I miss my husband. I can't wait till he returns.

Completion

So, we meet again, <name>, and you are in high spirits, I see.

The Stilwell home will be safe for another day, and from your story I see that there was no shortage of danger to be found. Well done.

Daphne and Jordan have helped the Church greatly, and having you protect their property--and their very lives--was the least we could do for them.

For your valor, you will be rewarded.
1652.sourceReview: Current own-ID script, infobox, original boundaries, five fields, linked identities, installed full record and all UA fields inspected. No primary unused/removed flag.

1653.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 21[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Type: Dungeon[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=3][/li][li]Class: [class=2][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6171/duthorian-rall]Duthorian Rall[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6181/jordan-stilwell]Jordan Stilwell[/url][/icon][/li][li]Sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]24[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]28[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1653.dialogueHTML:
The Test of Righteousness

Speak to Jordan Stilwell in Ironforge

Description

Actually, I have no doubt that Jordan himself would like to thank you, and seeing as I need a messenger to send word that his wife is safe, I think you'd be a perfect choice.

Jordan was to be a paladin of the Light before his dedication to his father's craft took him on another path--he's intimately familiar with our way of life and is considered among our most faithful.

He should still be in Ironforge--he likes to work outside the gates during the day, something about the cool mountain air.

Completion

Good day, <name>. The Light is with you, I trust?

What's that? You were sent by Duthorian!? My wife, how is she? I knew there was going to be trouble if I left. Please tell me she's... oh, thank goodness. I'm so glad that she's safe. The Defias were a threat long before these attacks, but now the King's advisors cannot deny it.

What else did Duthorian have to say?

You're the one that was sent to protect my wife? Then I thank you again, <name>. I couldn't think of a better test of valor than that.
1653.sourceReview: Current own-ID script, infobox, original boundaries, five fields, linked identities, installed full record and all UA fields inspected. No primary unused/removed flag.

1654.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 22[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Type: Dungeon[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=3][/li][li]Class: [class=2][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6181/jordan-stilwell]Jordan Stilwell[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6181/jordan-stilwell]Jordan Stilwell[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]25[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]29[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1654.dialogueHTML:
The Test of Righteousness

Using Jordan's Weapon Notes, find some Whitestone Oak Lumber, Bailor's Refined Ore Shipment, Jordan's Smithing Hammer, and a Kor Gem, and return them to Jordan Stilwell in Ironforge.
Whitestone Oak Lumber (1)
Jordan's Refined Ore Shipment (1)
Jordan's Smithing Hammer (1)
Purified Kor Gem (1)
Provided item:
Jordan's Weapon Notes (1)

Description

I'd like to reward you if you'd be willing to accept such a thing? Don't misunderstand me, my generosity is dependent on how much help you can be, but I see us both benefiting greatly from such an alliance.

I will craft for you a weapon worthy of what you've accomplished, a symbol of paladinhood and the Light, but you must gather the items I need to craft it. I've already started taking notes on the items, it just requires someone brave and skilled enough to recover them. What do you say, <class>?

Progress

The items you're seeking will be difficult to acquire, but I can assure you, the weapon I will craft for you will be worth the effort.

It will be my finest work to date, and only a small payment for the service you've done me.

Completion

This is wonderful! You've gotten all the items.

I should have no problem forging you a grand weapon with these. I've actually had the plans for doing this for some time, I just never had the opportunity to gather the goods. Thank you, <name>.

It feels good to have my father's hammer again... and a Kor gem, I never thought I'd see one of these myself.
1654.sourceReview: Current own-ID script, infobox, original boundaries, five fields, linked identities, installed full record and all UA fields inspected. No primary unused/removed flag.

1655.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 22[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Type: Elite[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=3][/li][li]Class: [class=2][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6241/bailor-stonehand]Bailor Stonehand[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6241/bailor-stonehand]Bailor Stonehand[/url][/icon][/li][li]Sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]25[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]29[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1655.dialogueHTML:
Bailor's Ore Shipment

Bring Jordan's Ore Shipment to Bailor Stonehand in Loch Modan.
Jordan's Ore Shipment (1)

Description

Ach, ya startled me, <man/woman>! Can't ya see I was lost in thought?

What's that? Jordan's shipment... fer Ironforge. Ahhh, yeah, I know whatcha speak of. Mo'grosh ogres... dat's who took me ol' friend's ore shipment. Caravan was headin' here from the Wetlands and was ambushed. The guard who survived their attack just passed away a few days ago--healer couldn't get to 'em fast enough.

If you want the shipment, you'll have to head northeast across the Loch. It's got to be there somewhere.

Progress

So, any luck yet? Haha, those ogres didn't get the best of ya yet, did they?

Completion

Yup yup, this is it. Ha! If I'd known you were really gonna head out there and fight some o' them ogres, I woulda given you a list of things to get instead of just this one thing. But, you're not here doin' business for me, are ya?.

A deal's a deal; Jordan wanted a shipment of me alloy, that's what he's gonna get.

Tell 'em hello fer me, and be safe, <class>.
1655.sourceReview: Current own-ID script, infobox, original boundaries, five fields, linked identities, installed full record and all UA fields inspected. No primary unused/removed flag.

1806.infoboxMarkup: [ul][li]Level: 22[/li][li]Requires level 20[/li][li]Side: [span class=icon-alliance]Alliance[/span][/li][li]Races: [race=1], [race=3][/li][li]Class: [class=2][/li][li][icon name=quest-start]Start: [url=/forever/npc=6181/jordan-stilwell]Jordan Stilwell[/url][/icon][/li][li][icon name=quest-end]End: [url=/forever/npc=6181/jordan-stilwell]Jordan Stilwell[/url][/icon][/li][li]Not sharable[/li][li]Difficulty: [color=r2]20[/color][small]  [/small][color=r3]25[/color][small]  [/small][color=r4]29[/color][/li][li]Added in patch [acronym="1.13.2.30406"]1.13.2[/acronym] "Classic"[/li][/ul]
1806.dialogueHTML:
The Test of Righteousness

Wait for Jordan Stilwell to finish forging a weapon for you.

Description

Why don't we go over to the forge and get started on this? I've been preparing for your arrival for some time, so it shouldn't take long at all.

When we're done, you'll be far more prepared to defend the Light than you have been, this much I swear.

I'll be somewhat honest, <name>, seeing the results of your exploits makes me somewhat envious. But knowing that I can contribute to your adventures in my own significant way does bring me some joy.

Completion

Here it is, <name>. A weapon worthy of a champion of the Light such as yourself. I've named it after a great dwarven <class> who was a friend of mine. His name was Verigan... Bosch Verigan. Please take it on behalf of myself and my wife. We owe you a great debt, and the world will be a safer place with one of your skill traveling the land.

98575.dialogueHTML:
Tainted Tablet

Read the Tainted Tablet and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
Tainted Tablet (Provided) (1)

Description

Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, <name>.

I usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer, Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.

Progress

Ah, you received my message. Excellent. We orcs have a long and turbulent history with the entities of the Nether, but now we forge our own path, in command of our destiny. You, too, can seize the power to shape the future for your people. Where our leaders falter, we are ready to press forward and claim our rightful place. You will be of eminence among the trolls.

Completion

You have just glimpsed the power that can be yours. The feeble and foolish among us are afraid of the path that we tread, but with boldness and cunning we can decide our own fates.

Guard your powers closely. The fearful lash out against that which they do not understand.

Now you are one of us. If you need training in spells then return to me.

98287.dialogueHTML:
Camping 101: Engineering

Speak with Sprite Jumpsprocket in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

 

Raise your engineering skill to 20 (1)

Description

Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit. I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.

98341.dialogueHTML:
The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

Seek out the Avatar of Saeyleenan in the southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the windborne cat.

Description

A spirit of your homeland has recently appeared here and has asked me to guide you to it. This windborne cat spirit has come to tutor and mentor you so that you may take the feline shape of the spirit on Zephras. All druids eventually seek this wisdom, though it seems your homeland has a slightly different shape than our traditional one. If you desire to take this spirit's feline form, you will need to undergo our trial. It can be found in the southern part of Moonglade, south of the twin bridges.

Completion

Greetings, young shen'dorei. I have come to you because I sense you are ready to undertake the trial to determine if you understand my spiritual nature or not.

I will have you take the trial of the Great Cat Spirit of Azeroth, but as you are from Zephras, I wished to oversee your progress myself. After all, it is my shape you would take, not that of an Azerothian cat spirit.

Let us begin.

98404.dialogueHTML:
The Great Windborne Cat Spirit

Recover the Relic of the Fang, Relic of the Claw, and Relic of the Silent Shadow from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the Avatar of Saeyleenan.
Relic of the Fang (1)
Relic of the Claw (1)
Relic of the Silent Shadow (1)

Description

In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity. In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them. Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.

Progress

Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?

Completion

Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.

I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young <class>.

98738.dialogueHTML:
Blessings of the Great Windborne Cat Spirit

Speak to Dendrite.

Description

Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. Unfortunately I have little left to teach you for the moment. I do hope you come and visit me in Zephras again someday. I sense promise in you, young shen'dorei. May the shadows forever hide you, your foes easily fall prey to your claws, and the winds guide your steps.

Completion

<Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>

I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the Great Cat Spirit. In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.

Now you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit.

97979.dialogueHTML:
The Goddess Provides

Cast Elune's Light and Shadowmeld.

 

Elune's Light cast (1)

 

Shadowmeld cast (1)

Description

You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun. Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil. Demonstrate Mother Moon's gifts, and bask in her blessings.

Progress

There are few joys so great as basking in Mother Moon's light.

Completion

You have seen what our goddess provides. Use it well, and she will never forsake you.

98386.dialogueHTML:
Alther's Mill

Slay 12 Greater Tarantulas and destroy 6 Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.

 

Greater Tarantula slain  (12)
  •  
Greater Tarantula (1)
  •  
Greater Tarantula (1)
  •  
Greater Tarantula (1)
 (1)
  •  
Tarantula Egg destroyed (6)

Description

Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill! If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments. Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.

Progress

A bite from one of the tarantulas out here can leave a worker out with a fever for a week. I'd prefer that didn't happen. At least, not on my watch.

Completion

The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.

I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, <name>!

3861.dialogueHTML:
CLUCK!

Find some Special Chicken Feed and return to your befriended chicken. When you find it, /cheer at it before trying to give it the Special Chicken Feed.
Special Chicken Feed (1)

Description

"Cluck... cluck... cluck... BACAW!

Cluck... cluck... cluck."

The chicken looks up at you and then starts to scratch its claws into the ground. You think it is spelling out a word, but you are not sure what it is. Could it be... S-A-L-D-E-A-N? Before you can ask, the chicken turns away and goes about its business.

Progress

The chicken stares at you with dark, cold eyes. It waits for you hungrily.

"BACAAAW!

Cluck...cluck...cluck."

Completion

"BACAW!!!"

The chicken starts to gobble up the feed you put down.

After a moment, the chicken looks around, startled. It uncomfortably shuffles back and forth. Is this chicken pregnant? You think you better check underneath it.

97583.dialogueHTML:
WRIGGLE.

Purchase Nutritious Slime Sludge and return to your befriended excitable slime. If it seems tired, try dancing with it again to catch its attention.
Nutritious Slime Sludge (1)

Description

<The little slime seems delighted and is attempting to mirror your motions as you dance. It begins to look weary though. The little slime hovers over a bit of sludge and absorbs it, looking slightly rejuvenated. It seems all of this dancing has tuckered it out. Perhaps someone in the Undercity canals sells more of this nutritious sludge?>

Progress

<The slime seems to regard you with interest.>

Completion

<The slime shudders with newfound energy. It seems to want to follow you, now that it has associated you with food.>
